1017.name: MetaZoo Mothman
1017.note: The token carries both an image and a 41s 1080p/40Mbps animation (arweave r4KO_QOT…, 208 MB, cached by Alchemy). The arweave gateway 502s, so the master came from Alchemy's cache and was transcoded to a web loop with ffmpeg (960px, CRF 30, audio stripped, +faststart) = 2.9 MB. The still image remains the poster frame. The still was also stored as .png while its bytes are JPEG (ffd8), the same extension mislabel as the CryptoPunks SVGs; renamed to .jpg.
